records.question: What is our profit margin?
records.raw: SELECT SUM(freight_value) / SUM(price) AS profit_margin FROM order_items
records.sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) / SUM(price) AS profit_margin FROM order_items

records.question: How many customers churned last month?
records.raw: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL

records.question: Which products are most popular?
records.raw: SELECT product_id FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10
records.sql: SELECT product_id FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: What is our lead conversion rate?
records.raw: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT mql_id) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT cd.mql_id) FROM closed_deals cd
records.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT mql_id) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT cd.mql_id) FROM closed_deals cd

records.question: How is the business doing this year?
records.raw: SELECT SUM(declared_monthly_revenue) FROM closed_deals WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM won_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
records.sql: SELECT SUM(declared_monthly_revenue) FROM closed_deals WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM won_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

records.question: How many orders were delivered later than the estimated date?
records.raw: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

records.question: Do orders delivered late receive lower review scores?
records.raw:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN r.review_score ELSE NULL END) 
FROM orders o 
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
records.sql:

records.question: Which state has the longest average delivery time?
records.raw: SELECT T1.customer_state FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id GROUP BY T1.customer_state ORDER BY AVG(T1.order_estimated_delivery_date - T1.order_purchase_timestamp) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many one-star reviews came from orders that were delivered late?
records.raw: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date AND r.review_score = 1
